question: What changes hands, rights and records when subscribing to a fund?
answer: Follow the saved illustrative process from instructions through claims, delivery, records and later service. The walk, legal-rights reading and transaction lanes answer different parts of the same question; an instruction, journal entry and completed settlement remain separate.

cells.text: Today: Issuer-led subscription. Cash at the fund’s custodian bank. Shares on the transfer-agent register. BUIDL is the taught comparison.
cells.label: Today: Issuer-led subscription. Cash at the fund’s custodian bank. Shares on the transfer-agent register. BUIDL is the taught comparison.

cells.text: What: Application only. No cash, no shares.
cells.label: What: Application only. No cash, no shares.

cells.text: Seats: Seat: Fund issuer · Today: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd. · Overlap: The BlackRock parent is not the issuer · Overtake: No · Seat: Transfer agent · Today: Securitize, LLC in the 2024 BUIDL appointment; current group name is Securitize…
cells.label: Seats: Seat: Fund issuer · Today: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd. · Overlap: The BlackRock parent is not the issuer · Overtake: No · Seat: Transfer agent · Today: Securitize, LLC in the 2024 BUIDL appointment; current group name is Securitize…

cells.text: What: Investor’s bank wires dollars. Custodian bank owes the fund a deposit. The fund credits capital.
cells.label: What: Investor’s bank wires dollars. Custodian bank owes the fund a deposit. The fund credits capital.

cells.text: Seats: Seat: Investor’s bank · Today: Unnamed · Overlap: Zero Hash can convert USDC to USD to subscribe (2024 announcement). Conversion is not the capital credit. · Overtake: No · Seat: Custodian bank · Today: The Bank of New York Mellon (brand as published) ·…
cells.label: Seats: Seat: Investor’s bank · Today: Unnamed · Overlap: Zero Hash can convert USDC to USD to subscribe (2024 announcement). Conversion is not the capital credit. · Overtake: No · Seat: Custodian bank · Today: The Bank of New York Mellon (brand as published) ·…

cells.text: What: The share is the TA register credit. A token is the same share only if that register turned.
cells.label: What: The share is the TA register credit. A token is the same share only if that register turned.

cells.text: Seats: Seat: Transfer agent / register · Today: Securitize, LLC fiduciary credit of the holder · Overlap: Token credited if the register instructs it. Wormhole is transport. · Overtake: No — unless someone books a second liability · Seat: Administrator · Today: BNY…
cells.label: Seats: Seat: Transfer agent / register · Today: Securitize, LLC fiduciary credit of the holder · Overlap: Token credited if the register instructs it. Wormhole is transport. · Overtake: No — unless someone books a second liability · Seat: Administrator · Today: BNY…

cells.text: What: Holder-to-holder: TA debit/credit. Fund has no cash entry.
cells.label: What: Holder-to-holder: TA debit/credit. Fund has no cash entry.

cells.text: Seats: Seat: Transfer agent · Today: Register must turn · Overlap: Wallet move without the register is not this role · Overtake: No
cells.label: Seats: Seat: Transfer agent · Today: Register must turn · Overlap: Wallet move without the register is not this role · Overtake: No

cells.text: What: Inverse of funding. Burn without the custodian-bank credit has not paid the investor.
cells.label: What: Inverse of funding. Burn without the custodian-bank credit has not paid the investor.

cells.text: Seats: Seat: Fund · Today: Dr shares / Cr cash · Overlap: Token burn is overlay, not USD · Overtake: No · Seat: Custodian / paying bank · Today: BNY moves the fund’s deposit out through the banking system · Overlap: — · Overtake: No
cells.label: Seats: Seat: Fund · Today: Dr shares / Cr cash · Overlap: Token burn is overlay, not USD · Overtake: No · Seat: Custodian / paying bank · Today: BNY moves the fund’s deposit out through the banking system · Overlap: — · Overtake: No

cells.text: A terms-based fund workflow, not the exchange-trade route above. BUIDL is a U.S.-connected example with an offshore fund issuer; it is not a template for every U.S. fund or a conclusion about investor eligibility.
cells.label: A terms-based fund workflow, not the exchange-trade route above. BUIDL is a U.S.-connected example with an offshore fund issuer; it is not a template for every U.S. fund or a conclusion about investor eligibility.

cells.text: Action: The prospective investor supplies the subscription documents required by the issue.
cells.label: Action: The prospective investor supplies the subscription documents required by the issue.

cells.text: An application is not yet an unconditional shareholding or a promise of admission.
cells.label: An application is not yet an unconditional shareholding or a promise of admission.

cells.text: Recover the current investor category, jurisdiction, minimum and acceptance conditions.
cells.label: Recover the current investor category, jurisdiction, minimum and acceptance conditions.

cells.text: Action: The subscription requires confirmation of funds at the issuer’s custodian under the issue terms.
cells.label: Action: The subscription requires confirmation of funds at the issuer’s custodian under the issue terms.

cells.text: Sending money and acquiring shares are separate events; rejected or incomplete subscriptions need their own treatment.
cells.label: Sending money and acquiring shares are separate events; rejected or incomplete subscriptions need their own treatment.

cells.text: Match received funds to the accepted subscription and allocation.
cells.label: Match received funds to the accepted subscription and allocation.

rows.label: Step 3: Issue shares and record the holder

cells.text: Action: The appointed agent records the shareholding pursuant to the issuer’s instructions and governing terms.
cells.label: Action: The appointed agent records the shareholding pursuant to the issuer’s instructions and governing terms.

cells.text: The investor receives fund-share rights, not direct title to each portfolio asset.
cells.label: The investor receives fund-share rights, not direct title to each portfolio asset.

cells.text: Tie the share class, quantity and investor identity to the recognized holding.
cells.label: Tie the share class, quantity and investor identity to the recognized holding.

rows.label: Step 4: Transfer to an eligible recipient

cells.text: Action: A transfer request must satisfy the issue’s transfer conditions before the recognized holding changes.
cells.label: Action: A transfer request must satisfy the issue’s transfer conditions before the recognized holding changes.

cells.text: Technical delivery and an authorized transfer of fund-share rights must be connected by the issue’s rules.
cells.label: Technical delivery and an authorized transfer of fund-share rights must be connected by the issue’s rules.

cells.text: Verify recipient eligibility and the agent’s recognized record update.
cells.label: Verify recipient eligibility and the agent’s recognized record update.

cells.text: Action: Apply the offering terms to a redemption request, share cancellation and payment.
cells.label: Action: Apply the offering terms to a redemption request, share cancellation and payment.

cells.text: Redemption rights depend on fund terms. A request, token burn and received cash are distinct evidence points.
cells.label: Redemption rights depend on fund terms. A request, token burn and received cash are distinct evidence points.

cells.text: Verify eligibility, timing, valuation, any suspension terms and actual payout.
cells.label: Verify eligibility, timing, valuation, any suspension terms and actual payout.

catalog_context.title: Who actually controls the crypto infrastructure
